Intern who survives the dog park and later becomes an ambassador.

How Intern Dana connects

  • Faction: Night Vale Community Radio — Dana begins as an intern at Night Vale Community Radio.
  • Location: the dog park — Dana is lost in the dog park and comes back changed.

What is Intern Dana?

Dana Cardinal begins as a Night Vale Community Radio intern, is lost in the dog park, and returns as a diplomat the town has to take seriously — a rare intern who is not only a memorial.

Key threads lead to Night Vale Community Radio and the dog park.
